ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Introductory Machine Learning. Description: Machine learning has been thriving in many areas for both research and industry. It offers solutions to problems that traditional approaches may not be able to deal with or fall short in efficiency. From supervised to unsupervised learning, this course is set to give students a broad understanding in modern machine learning methods and techniques. During the course, students are expected to acquire knowledge and skills in solving practical problems in clustering and classification, using techniques such as k-means, Gaussian mixture models, decision trees, support vector machines and neural networks. This course requires LING490 or equivalent in programming and understanding in probability and statistics as prerequisite. Prerequisites: LING 406 or LING 490
